newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian coalition expects to be asked to take power.
newsitem.headline: Indian coalition expects to be asked to take power.

text.p: India's United Front expects President Shankar Dayal Sharma to ask it on Sunday to form a new centre-left government, alliance leader Chandrababu Naidu said.

Naidu, who is chief minister of Andhra Pradesh state, told reporters after a delegation of United Front leaders met Sharma that they had staked a joint claim, signed by 15 parties, to form the government.
Prime minister-in-waiting Inder Kumar Gujral was not among the United Front leaders who met Sharma.
"We have staked a claim to form the government," Naidu said. "We are hopeful of forming the government very soon."
Asked when Sharma would invite the United Front to form a new government, he said: "We are expecting to be called today."

Naidu, who spearheaded the efforts on Friday and Saturday to find a consensus United Front candidate, said he had asked caretaker Finance Minister P.Chidambaram's Tamil Maanila Congress to reconsider its decision, announced on Saturday, not to join the government.
